scripts.release:patch: pnpm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" && git push origin main
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" && git push origin main
scripts.release:major: pnpm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" && git push origin main
scripts.reinstall: pnpm build && npm uninstall -g zhc && npm install -g
